## Current delivery contract — user-approved two-outcome stack
Owner: PR B. One PR per complete outcome, NOT one PR per bead. Keep detailed beads and cohesive internal commits for tracking; consolidate existing draft foundations into their owning feature PR where practical. PR B stacks on independently usable PR A. Include owning PR documentation and validation there. This supersedes earlier per-bead/prerequisite PR instructions and historical comments. Closed foundation status is not outcome acceptance.
New-feature E2E requires explicit human UX approval in zaq-emb.32; no self-approval.

After handled execution outcome persistence, serialize synchronization against new requests:

1. Capture the latest completed runtime context and a consistent history delta through D.
2. Merge by canonical references, retaining valid execution exchanges and respecting failed-runtime disposal policy.
3. Apply context while idle through Jido's existing `ai.react.context.modify` mechanism, using an operation ID and exact runtime incarnation.
4. Advance the stored cursor to D only once context application is confirmed.
5. Release admission for the next request. Associations committed after D remain future deltas.

Jido context replacement during an active run is deferred until terminalization and stores only one pending operation. Do not submit stale replacement snapshots mid-run. Acknowledgment of a queued operation is not confirmation it was applied.

If synchronization fails, preserve the old cursor or invalidate/rebuild the runtime. Never advance the cursor independently of its corresponding context. Scope this to in-memory lifecycle consistency; process-crash durability remains separate.

Prerequisites: fixed-cursor transformer integration. Files: Factory/ServerManager/Executor lifecycle and Jido contract integration tests. Action reuse: existing Jido ai.react.context.modify at idle boundary, acknowledged exact incarnation; no mid-run replacement queue. Tests first: context applied before cursor advance, simultaneous new request serialized, delta through D only, A/B reread dedupe, stale runtime PID, failed application and failed-run disposal. Mocking: external LLM; actual Jido runtime. Documentation: Agent runtime/context contract.

Execution requirements: planning only until assigned for implementation. Preserve existing uncommitted work and progress comments; do not infer completion from historical tests. Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md and applicable service guides before affected work. Write immediate unit/integration/property regression tests BEFORE implementation. Mock only genuine external boundaries; keep internal domain paths real. Run isolated tests and mix q per issue; final precommit belongs to the dedicated final gate. New feature E2E authoring waits for zaq-emb.32. No commit/push authorization is implied.

## Alignment update — 2026-10-07 / a0c8796e
Preserve context-apply acknowledgement before cursor advancement/admission release. Reuse exact incarnation checks and tool budgets. A successful usage-accounting job or delivery confirmation is not evidence that Jido applied context.

Preserve baseline contracts and committed test suites in zaq-emb.30; extend coverage rather than duplicating it. Tests precede production changes; no status change or completion is asserted.

comments.text: Implementation seam audit: StreamEvents marks RequestRegistry terminal before Agent.Api.persist_response_context writes the Engine outcome; Jido can already be idle then. Therefore synchronization cannot be an unfenced post-stream replacement: ServerManager must serialize next-request admission through completed-outcome handling and confirmed context apply. Reuse existing exact-incarnation stop/binding checks and Jido ai.react.context.modify plus applied_context_ops acknowledgement; Factory owns native runtime mechanics, Engine execution_history/3 owns authorized deltas, HistoryLoader owns projection merge, ServerManager owns cursor/context/admission lifecycle. No Agent DB reads or exposed Action/tool. First regression package will verify actual idle apply/idempotent op evidence, stale PID exclusion and active-run refusal (no pending_context_op), followed by manager serialization and warm next-request acceptance. Existing per-turn .5 tests remain preservation baseline; no new product decision.

Native idle apply package committed 29843b2b (regressions first). Factory.apply_history_context/3 requires exact PID + nonempty operation ID, checks idle, dispatches existing ai.react.context.modify, and accepts only matching applied_context_ops evidence + exact resulting context + no queued operation. Real configured/Jido tests cover same-op idempotency, rebinding same op to a different snapshot returns unconfirmed, malformed/name targets rejected, stale PID never reaches new same-scope incarnation, active actual HTTP-blocked run refuses without pending_context_op and completes its original exchange. No internal Jido mocks; only external LLM HTTP. Public docs explicitly require caller-held exclusive admission and state manager lease integration is pending; helper is not a standalone synchronization guarantee. 127 tests +3 properties, mix q/diff/hooks pass; formatter-only hook layout corrected without behavioral change. Next: regression-first ServerManager per-scope admission lease held through handled Engine outcome + confirmed idle apply/cursor commit, warm next-request delta and replacement/race failures. .16 remains in_progress, no push/publication.

Lease package underway (tests first, not yet committed): ServerManager remains lifecycle owner; extracted internal HistoryLifecycle ledger keeps scope/PID/cursors/owner monitor/waiters cohesive rather than adding storage/provider semantics to manager. Local-only mechanism, not an independently exposed Action: inputs exact actor-bound runtime plus incorporated context/cursor source vector; process-owned lease token cannot transfer, reopen or rebind sources, and only Factory confirmed context apply releases/advances. Owner failure/native apply failure invalidates; replacement cleanup releases stale waiters. Begin waits on owner-monitored lease instead of a 60s timeout which could silently abandon an admission during the existing 300s run budget; Jido still bounds execution. Trace+sys barriers test genuine deferred GenServer calls (no production test hooks/sleeps). Existing empty-state assertions extended with the new empty ledger, preserving exact cleanup checks; old optional lifecycle metadata cleanup follows existing credential-dependency compatibility pattern. Production Executor/API persistence wiring remains next; no standalone synchronization claim.

Lease ledger committed 8bc49ad2. Actual configured/Jido tests prove queued next caller cannot acquire before applied-op confirmation/cursor commit; lease owner/token/source vector cannot transfer/regress/reopen; stale completion never affects a new incarnation; owner exit or failed busy application invalidates instead of advancing; actor mismatch denied. Manager keeps scope lifecycle authority; internal HistoryLifecycle delegates only native mutation to Factory and owns no Engine/provider/storage access. Fresh incarnation ledger initializes from explicit history_cursors, never overwrite on warm ensure. Owner-monitor admission wait avoids independent 60s expiry during longer bounded native runs; same-owner reentry is rejected; draining/current-incarnation checks precede grant/apply. Existing exact empty cleanup assertions extended, optional old ledger cleanup follows preexisting credential-state compatibility. Monotonic/stale-token property passes. 130 tests +3 properties with mix q/diff/hooks pass. Executor/API handled-outcome integration remains next and is explicitly documented as pending; .16 in_progress, not a standalone synchronization guarantee and not published.

Boundary wiring regression-first underway: extended existing actual provider/Jido three-turn acceptance to require released incorporated ledger and one retained canonical UUID per root/background/answer, then same-PID next request after D retaining both tool pairs. Preimplementation test failed missing ledger. Reuse assessment: Engine execution_history via confidential NodeRouter remains only grant/cursor/content authority; Factory remains only native mutation; HistoryLoader extends conversion with persisted answer UUID binding and completed-exchange classification. HistorySync is local-only lifecycle orchestration, not independently composable/exposed Action (process-owned exact-incarnation lease and API-held persistence continuation cannot safely become tools/workflow Actions). API session is an opaque local reference passed explicitly to Executor/Pipeline, never persisted or attached to outgoing metadata; ServerManager owns descriptors/leases and only returns the caller-owned session. API confirms successful persisted outcome before delta read/apply/release; unfinished scopes disposed in try/after, including direct canonical Executor calls with no persistence owner. Synchronization failure retains persisted delivery but disposes runtime. Pending tests for true persistence/admission races and failure branches; not complete.

Boundary synchronization committed locally 6ffd8c31 atop 8bc49ad2 /29843b2b. Acceptance: provider/Jido A->A+B three-turn root followed by same-PID next warm request after D retains both tool pairs and sees each canonical root/background/answer UUID once. Real Engine finalization query barrier pauses outcome persistence after Jido status completed/no active_request_id and RequestRegistry terminalization; another actual Manager admission remains deferred with old cursors, then receives confirmed context/cursors after commit+native apply. No sleeps or production hooks; trace/sys/telemetry at real transaction boundary. Real provider boundary grant revocation leaves completed canonical answer/delivery intact but stops runtime; direct session exceptions and failed persisted outcome dispose without cursor advancement; binding/session immutable and process-owned. Previous actual idle apply/stale-PID/failed busy apply/owner abandonment/property contracts remain passing. Page-safe read cursors (not captured unseen upper ends) publish only after confirmation. Current native input carries UUID via extra_refs; persisted final body/UUID reconcile on completed context (protect Pipeline fallback), and completed tool exchanges become history rather than forever-active turns. Action reuse/ownership as previous comment; no new Actions, native/storage paths duplicated, or outbound token/lease metadata. Broader preservation sweep: 2097 tests,56 properties,17 doctests pass (21 existing exclusions), including all Agent/Engine conversation suites and email bridge/runtime/HTML preservation. Final exact changes: mix q +62 focused tests/3 properties +diff/hooks pass. Existing unused ServerManager alias warning remains unrelated. All commits local, no push/merge; .31 final integrated review/coverage/E2E/precommit and separate .32 human UX gate still pending.
